syntax overview:

on:
  push: {branches: [main], tags: ["v*"], paths-ignore: ["**.md"]}
  pull_request:
  schedule: [{cron: "30 2 * * *"}]     # min hour dom month dow (UTC)
  workflow_dispatch:                   # manual button (+ inputs:)
  workflow_call:                       # reusable workflow (+ inputs:)

permissions: {contents: read, id-token: write}   # least privilege
concurrency: {group: ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true}
env: {AWS_REGION: eu-central-1}                  # workflow-wide

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [lint]                       # run after lint succeeded
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' # condition for the job
    environment: production             # approvals, env secrets
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: {python: ["3.12", "3.13"], os: [ubuntu-latest]}
    services:                           # side containers, e.g. a DB
      db: {image: "pgvector/pgvector:pg17", ports: ["5432:5432"]}
    outputs: {image: "${{ steps.push.outputs.image }}"}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - id: push
        run: echo "image=repo:$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - if: failure()                   # also: always(), success()
        run: echo "### failed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

Error or symptomCause and fix
The lockfile at uv.lock needs to be updatedpyproject.toml changed without a new lock: run uv lock, commit uv.lock.
Tests pass locally, fail in CIFile not committed (check .gitignore), missing env var, absolute path, timezone, or a dependency only in your global Python.
ModuleNotFoundError: credit_apiPackage not installed: run via uv run, keep the src/ layout and the build-system table.
Required check "Expected — Waiting for status"The workflow was skipped (path filter) or the check name changed (matrix); require one aggregator job such as ci-ok instead.
! [rejected] … (stale info) on pushSomeone pushed to your branch since your last fetch. Look with git log HEAD..origin/<branch> before forcing anything.
fatal: Need to specify how to reconcile divergent branchesLocal and remote branch both have new commits. Usually git pull --rebase; set pull.rebase true once.
Connection reset by peer from a containerApp listens on 127.0.0.1; start it with --host 0.0.0.0.

Error or symptomCause and fix
Exit code 137 / OutOfMemoryErrorProcess killed for memory: raise task memory, or train on a smaller sample in CI.
CannotPullContainerError on rollbackThe image was expired by the ECR lifecycle policy; keep release images longer.
expected 384 dimensions, not 768 (pgvector)Embedding model changed without re-indexing; rebuild the index for the new model.
Job refused: branch not allowed to deploy to the environmentThe environment's deployment-branch rule (only main). Working as intended; deploy from main.
AccessDenied … UpdateExpressGatewayServiceThe deploy role's service ARN pattern does not match; compare with aws ecs list-services and fix permissions-deploy.json.
DISTRIBUTION CHECK FAILEDDecisions implausible: check DECISION_THRESHOLD, /health model version and input changes before anything else; do not approve production.
Could not load credentials from any providersMissing permissions: id-token: write in the workflow or job.
Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityTrust policy sub does not match: check repo name, branch, environment name (case-sensitive) and the OIDC provider ARN.

Error or symptomCause and fix
AccessDenied ... ecr:InitiateLayerUploadPermissions policy names the wrong repository ARN or region.
tag invalid: ... already exists (ECR)Immutable tags: you pushed the same tag twice. Use the SHA; never latest.
exec format error in the taskImage built for arm64 on a Mac; build with --platform linux/amd64 or in CI.
Unable to assume the service linked roleIAM roles are eventually consistent; wait a minute after setup.sh and retry.
Service never becomes healthyWrong container-port or health-check-path; /health returns 503 when the model file is missing; read the task logs in CloudWatch.
Smoke test: wrong versionOld tasks still serve traffic during a deployment; the script retries, increase attempts if needed.
UntrustedTypesFoundException (MLflow)MLflow 3 uses skops; pass skops_trusted_types for types you trust.
Quality gate red, nothing changedUsually the evaluation changed (split, rows, parsing), not the model: compare predictions on the same rows. Widen max_drop only from measured variance (scripts/variance.py).

Error or symptomCause and fix
Schedule did not runSchedules run on the default branch only, can be delayed, and stop after 60 days of inactivity (public repos).
Secret is empty in a PR runSecrets are not passed to PRs from forks; run that job on push or behind a label.
eval budget of $0.5 used upThe cost cap triggered: check for a loop, a cache miss storm or a changed prompt.
